hints.title: Finite Sequential Candidates
hints.text: All sequential digits come from substrings of the template sequence string 123456789.

hints.title: Iterate Lengths
hints.text: For length from 1 to 9, slide a window across 123456789 to generate each valid sequential integer.

hints.title: Filter by Range
hints.text: Convert each substring to integer; if low <= val <= high, add to the answer list and return sorted.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every number between low and high (up to 10^9) exceeds time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating only sequential digit numbers by sliding over 123456789 runs in constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes the tiny set of valid sequential numbers and generates them directly.
complexity.notes: There are only 45 total sequential digit numbers between 1 and 10^9.
